title: A Bridge Built with Different Plans
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空例。実在の人物・調査結果・実証的な心理効果を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: An imaginary international partnership brings together two small towns that intend to create educational materials for children living in communities affected by seasonal flooding.
sentences.ja: 季節的洪水の影響を受ける地域の子ども向け教材を制作しようとする二つの小さな町が架空の国際協力を結ぶ。

sentences.en: One group has experience developing visually attractive teaching materials and proposes preparing a complete collection before sending it to the partner community for distribution.
sentences.ja: 一方は視覚的に魅力ある教材を作った経験があり、完全な教材集を準備してから配布用に相手地域に送ることを提案する。

sentences.en: The other group welcomes the offer but asks whether the materials can be developed gradually, since the local teachers have not yet identified which topics and formats would be most useful under their particular circumstances.
sentences.ja: 他方は申し出を歓迎するが、地元教師はその事情で最も有用なテーマや形式をまだ特定していないので段階的に作れるか尋ねる。

sentences.en: The partners realize that agreement about the broad purpose of a project does not necessarily imply agreement about the process through which it should be carried out.
sentences.ja: 活動の広い目的についての合意が実施過程についての合意を必ずしも意味しないと両者は気づく。

sentences.en: The first group initially regards its detailed production schedule as a sign of commitment, because completing a substantial collection would require considerable effort from its volunteers.
sentences.ja: 当初一方は大量の教材完成にボランティアのかなりの努力が必要なので詳細な制作日程を関与の証しと見なす。

sentences.en: Its partners, however, are concerned that receiving a large collection before discussing the needs of its intended users might create an obligation to distribute resources that are not sufficiently relevant to the local educational context.
sentences.ja: しかし相手は対象利用者の必要を話す前に大量の教材を受け取ると地元の教育状況に十分関連しない資源を配布する義務が生じると懸念する。

sentences.en: They explain that a beautifully designed lesson may still be difficult to use if it assumes access to equipment that is unavailable or refers to experiences that are unfamiliar to the children.
sentences.ja: 美しく設計された授業でも入手不能な機器へのアクセスを前提としたり子どもに未知の経験に言及したりすると使いにくいかもしれないと説明する。

sentences.en: The difficulty therefore concerns not the generosity of the original offer but the distribution of responsibility for deciding what constitutes useful assistance.
sentences.ja: 困難は当初の申し出の寛大さでなく何が有益な支援を構成するか決める責任の配分に関係する。

sentences.en: Rather than abandoning the planned collaboration, the groups agree to prepare a small set of sample materials and examine them together before committing resources to a larger collection.
sentences.ja: 予定協力を放棄せず小規模見本を作り大量制作に資源を投入する前に共同検討することに合意する。

sentences.en: They establish a procedure through which teachers can identify features requiring adaptation and suggest alternatives without being expected to express approval of every proposed design.
sentences.ja: 全提案を承認するよう期待されず修正必要な特徴を特定し代替案を出せる手順を設ける。

sentences.en: The volunteers also discuss which aspects of the project should remain consistent across the collection and which decisions should be left to educators familiar with the circumstances in which the materials will be used.
sentences.ja: 教材集全体で一貫させる側面と使用事情に詳しい教育者に委ねる判断についても議論する。

sentences.en: They acknowledge that this arrangement may initially appear slower than producing every lesson at once, but it might reduce the need for extensive revisions after distribution.
sentences.ja: 一度に全授業を作るより当初は遅く見えても配布後の大規模修正を減らし得ると認める。

sentences.en: The groups subsequently prepare a shared account of their objectives, the resources available to each partner, and the decisions that remain open to revision.
sentences.ja: その後両者は目的、各相手が利用できる資源、修正可能な判断について共通の説明を用意する。

sentences.en: They avoid interpreting a request for modification as evidence that the original contribution was unappreciated, just as they avoid treating expressions of gratitude as proof that no further modification is needed.
sentences.ja: 修正要求を元の貢献への感謝不足の証拠と解釈せず、感謝表明をさらなる修正が不要な証拠とも扱わない。

sentences.en: The fictional partnership cannot establish an effective approach to any actual disaster relief or educational program, which would require knowledge of the real communities and their priorities.
sentences.ja: 架空協力は実在の災害支援や教育計画の有効手法を確定できず、それには実地域と優先事項の知識を要する。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, it illustrates why communication about the design of a project can be as significant as agreement about the resources that one group intends to provide.
sentences.ja: それでも活動設計についての意思疎通が一方の提供予定資源についての合意と同じほど重要になり得る理由を示す。

sentences.en: International cooperation can involve differences not only in the resources available to participants but also in their expectations about how decisions should be reached.
sentences.ja: 国際協力には参加者の利用可能資源だけでなく判断方法への期待の違いも伴い得る。

sentences.en: An offer that seems complete from the provider's perspective may leave other participants with little opportunity to influence matters that will affect their everyday activities.
sentences.ja: 提供者の観点で完全に見える申し出は他参加者の日常活動に影響する事柄に関与する機会をほとんど与えないかもしれない。

sentences.en: Responsible collaboration consequently requires ways for participants to communicate their knowledge and revise shared plans without interpreting every disagreement as a rejection of the partnership itself.
sentences.ja: 責任ある協力には全対立を協力自体の拒絶と解釈せず知識を伝え共同計画を修正する方法が必要だ。

sentences.en: The bridge between these imaginary towns becomes stronger when both communities can contribute to the decisions that determine what they build together.
sentences.ja: 架空の町の橋は共同で築くものを決める判断に双方が貢献できるとき強くなる。

vocabulary.definition: something one feels required to do
change made to suit a situation

questions.prompt: What is the intended purpose of the partnership?
options: Create educational materials for children in communities affected by flooding.

questions.prompt: What difference appears despite their shared purpose?
options: They have opposite goals for children's education.
They disagree about when and how materials should be designed.

questions.prompt: Why could a completed collection create an obligation?
options: Partners may feel expected to distribute resources before assessing their suitability.
The resources have no production costs.
Teachers are unable to express gratitude.
questions.explanation_ja: 適切さ確認前の配布負担。

questions.prompt: Which assumption could make a lesson difficult to use?
options: That teachers will read the materials.
The existence of any educational purpose.
That local experiences can be discussed.

questions.prompt: What did both groups agree to do first?
options: Create and jointly examine a small sample.
questions.explanation_ja: 小規模見本の共同確認。

questions.prompt: Why might slower initial production be worthwhile?
options: It guarantees that no revision will be needed.
It removes the resources available to volunteers.
It could reduce costly revisions after distribution.
questions.explanation_ja: 配布後の修正を減らせる。

questions.prompt: What distinction is made about gratitude?
options: Requests for change always express hostility.
Appreciation does not necessarily imply satisfaction with every detail.
questions.explanation_ja: 感謝と改善要望は両立。

questions.prompt: What does the fictional case not establish?
options: An effective method for actual disaster relief programs.
The possibility of disagreeing about design.
questions.explanation_ja: 実支援の有効性は未実証。

questions.prompt: Which statement captures the central argument?
options: International partners should accept every predesigned resource.
The fastest possible production is always most useful.
Cooperation requires sharing decision-making as well as resources.
Disagreement shows that a partnership has failed.

paraphrases.rewrite: The partners consider which choices local educators should make.

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 提供側と受け手の視点。

制作側と受入側の対比。
